results.scenario: Ada North, the seeded owner of Northwharf Ltd (organization 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001), reads the organization's cash position by calling the MCP tool cash_snapshot after the scenario seeds a per-run GBP account with a non-zero balance, one debit transaction (which counts as burn), and one transfer_out transaction (which is an outflow but not burn). The scenario mints an owner access token via Auth0 password grant (using AuthClient.getTokenByPassword with customFetch that rewrites https to http and patches the issuer in OIDC discovery responses), then sends a stateless tools/call request to the MCP endpoint with Authorization: Bearer. The assertions verify that the MCP response is a successful tool result (isError field absent, content array has exactly one text entry), the JSON payload parses and contains exactly the keys asOf, burnWindowDays, currencies, and recentOutflows, asOf is a valid ISO-8601 timestamp, burnWindowDays is 30, currencies is a non-empty sorted array with an entry for GBP (the seeded currency) plus any other currencies the organization holds, each currencies entry has balanceMinor equal to the independent sum(balance_minor) grouped by currency for the organization (cross-checked via direct SQL), each burnMinor equals the independent sum of debit transaction amounts in the last 30 days for that currency (excluding the seeded transfer_out, confirming internal transfers are not counted as burn), each runwayMonths equals round((balance/burn)*100)/100 when burn is positive or null when burn is zero, recentOutflows is an array of at most 8 entries equal in order and content to the independent top-8 debit/transfer_out transactions ordered by occurred_at descending (ids match, amounts parsed as integers match, timestamps as ISO-8601 match), no credential fields (token, accessToken, authorization, password, secret) leak into the snapshot body, and the response Content-Type header is application/json. The scenario cleans up the seeded transactions and account with verified rowCount for each DELETE, and closes the Postgres connection in a finally block.

stepsValidation.description: Seed per-run GBP account and transactions for discriminating cash position
Mint owner access token via Auth0 password grant
Call cash_snapshot MCP tool and verify result envelope
Cross-check snapshot against independent SQL queries
